notes.title: Language Update and Bugfixes
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948074/e6d0965bbd7beba71c8b1e82744e809dc84d757f.jpg[/img]

We are excited to announce that we  – additionally to some bug fixes – added four more languages to our roster. After todays patch, you will be able to select Arabic, Korean, Traditional and Simplified Chinese subtitles.

You can find the complete patch notes here:

[b]Deponia 4.0.1386 Changelog[/b]

[list]
[*] Engine Update to Visionaire 5.0.1
[/list]
[list]
[*] Added crossplatform savegame syncing on Steam
[/list]
[list]
[*] Added Visionaire Config Tool 2.0 for MacOS and Linux 
[/list]


[list]
[*] Added Simplified Chinese subtitles
[/list]
[list]
[*] Added Traditional Chinese subtitles
[/list]
[list]
[*] Added Korean subtitles
[/list]
[list]
[*] Added Arabic subtitles
[/list]

[list]
[*] Fixed: Localization errors in Droggeljug mode
[/list]
[list]
[*] Fixed: Missing dialog option when using the radio talk to Cletus while playing with czech subtitles
[/list]
[list]
[*] Fixed: Crash when talking on the radio with Cletus
[/list]
[list]
[*] Fixed: Missing pigeons when leaving the magnetic field minigame
[/list]
[list]
[*] Fixed: Errors in the Mosaic minigame preventing the correct movement of tiles 
[/list]
[list]
[*] Fixed: Disappearing booze when using clear water in a specific order
[/list]
[list]
[*] Fixed: Disappearing non-glowing cotton candy when used with the mosaic wall 
[/list]
[list]
[*] Fixed: Rufus being stuck after destroying the lamp with the slingshot in chapter 3
[/list]

notes.title: Deponia - Patch 3.2 scheduled for Monday 17.11.2014
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

we’re happy to announce that we are releasing the patch 3.2 for Deponia on Monday 17th, 2014.

This update brings Deponia to the engine and patch level of Deponia - The Complete Journey, containing performance improvements and several hundred bugfixes throughout the game. But that also means that you will need to re-download the whole game. Savegames will stay compatible. 

Please note that there might be some bugs included in your savegames which can’t be solved by the patch. In that case, please contact our support team via support@daedalic.de. They have already prepared all potentially necessary savegames for you! 

Changelog Deponia 3.2

Fixed low frame rate on some systems
Fixed possible plotstopper on the Operator's Platform
Fixed problems with the Droggeljug mode and achievement for some players
Fixed black screen problem for players with Retina Macs
Added Portuguese language
Added Linux platform

notes.title: Big language update: Spanish and Italian Voices are available now!
notes.content:
Deponia now is updated to version 2.0 and adds languages with full synchronization:
	* Spanish
	* Italian

Interface and subtitle languages include
	* Turkish
	* Bulgarian
	* Greek

[b]Multilanguage Tool[/b]
Actually, all available languages are integrated in our multilanguage tool. You just install your game once and choose the languages you want.

Like in our latest released games, Steam Cloud is integrated to manage your savegames. All your old savegames are compatible to this new version.
This update provides additional bugfixing and an optimized performance.

tags.feature: Steam Cloud is integrated to manage your savegames.
